rule: A frozen seed set is not preregistration.  A local mtime or a fresh commit is not historical evidence.  These runs keep their numbers and their provenance; what changes is only the label attached to them.
classification: Both runs are EXPLORATORY / DEVELOPMENT evidence and must be reported as such.  They cannot become preregistered, now or later.
what_this_does_not_mean: It does not invalidate the numbers: the runs completed, the runner hash was unchanged across them, and the artifacts are hashed.
It does not invalidate any mathematical result; G3 is about experimental provenance only.
It does not assert that any particular venue forbids exploratory evidence; no such requirement has been established here.
if_a_prior_record_exists: If an independent timestamped record predating outcome access is found, verify its CONTENT -- hypotheses, endpoints, comparator set, seeds, budget, stopping and analysis -- against these runs before upgrading anything.  Do not upgrade on the existence of a record alone.
